channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zach Randolph | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zach Randolph from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Zach Randolph, Mike Conley
item.description:
[Highlight] Klay Thompson:

“I actually do have a lot of respect for the grind house, Mike Conley, Zach Randolph, and MarcGasol…This new team though, I don’t know man. They just talk a lot. They’ve always talked a lot, and never really backed it up either. So, I don’t really respect that...”

Klay Thompson on Zach Randolph, Mike Conley, Nov 24, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Josh Childress on Zach Randolph, John Wall, Al Harrington
item.description:
“When the opportunity presented itself, the entire ownership group is pretty much based here in LA, guys that I know. Some real estate guys, myself, Al Harrington, Zach Randolph, John Wall, some NBA connectivity, it was a great opportunity for us to take that next step.”

Josh Childress on Zach Randolph, John Wall, Al Harrington, Dec 30, 2022. Source: SiliconValley.com.

item.title: Steven Adams on Zach Randolph
item.description:
“Because Z-Bo (Zach Randolph) punched me in the face as a rookie, and then you guys lost Game 7 because of it — just to bring up some old stuff.”

Steven Adams on Zach Randolph, Sep 17, 2021. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Zach Randolph:

“He was a guy who really had great hands, a great skill to rebound and a great skill to catch and work underneath the bucket, very different from most anybody else.... He always brought it. He was aggressive and he competed every night.”

Gregg Popovich on Zach Randolph, Dec 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Rudy Gay on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Rudy Gay on Zach Randolph:

“One of the best teammates you could have. He gave it his all out there every time he touched the basketball court. He was an enforcer and he did a lot for the city of Memphis. He was a great player.”

Rudy Gay on Zach Randolph, Dec 28, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Vlade Divac on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Kings GMVlade Divac on death of Zach Randolph’s brother.

“We are deeply saddened to learn of Roger Randolph’s tragic death. As a cherished member of the Kings family, our prayers, heartfelt condolences & thoughts are with Zach & his family during this painful & difficult time.”

Vlade Divac on Zach Randolph, Jun 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarcJSpearsESPN.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Gasol on Randolph:

“He's just on the road now for his job ... But he's one of the founding fathers of who we are.”

Marc Gasol on Zach Randolph, Jan 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @MyMikeCheck.

item.title: Raymond Brothers on Zach Randolph
item.description:
From Zach Randolph's agent, Ray Brothers:

“As we have said from the beginning, the reports regarding Zach Randolph were false and misleading. After being accused of marijuana possession, all charges have been dropped. He was never arrested with any marijuana in or on his possession. He has been cited for delaying a police officer. It's defamatory for someone to say anything to the contrary.”

Raymond Brothers on Zach Randolph, Sep 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @daldridgetnt.

item.title: David Fizdale on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Grizzlies coachDavid Fizdale on Zach Randolph's transition to sixth man this season:

“It has been seamless. He has never bickered once to the press – not one time. You can go back through every paper, article or anything and he never complained. There were days when he was frustrated. He just stayed with it, and he's embraced it. He's got to be in the conversation of Sixth Man of the Year. I don't know how he can't be one of the finalists for that, looking at what he's done on the glass and from a scoring stand point. I think a lot of the sixth men do a lot of scoring. Z-Bo is in the trenches for us, grabbing rebounds for us every night. I'm sure he leads the league for double-doubles off the bench. Yes, I am pitching for him, if you're wondering.”

David Fizdale on Zach Randolph, Apr 1, 2017. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: David Fizdale on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Michael Wallace:David Fizdale on passing of Zach Randolph's mother:

“We've got to take care of our brother. Losing his mother on Thanksgiving was devastating.”

David Fizdale on Zach Randolph, Nov 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @MyMikeCheck.

item.title: David Fizdale on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Ronald Tillery:David Fizdale on Zach Randolph:

“I'm kicking myself for not playing him those last 3 minutes... Zbo and I talked about it and he understands.”

David Fizdale on Zach Randolph, Nov 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @CAGrizBeat.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Zach Randolph, Marc Gasol
item.description:
“Generally, we were playing with two bigs in Memphis with Marc (Gasol) and Zach (Randolph), so we’re trying to do some things there. I anticipate us playing a lot more small ball this year.”

Dave Joerger on Zach Randolph, Marc Gasol, Sep 28, 2016. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Mario Chalmers on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Mario Chalmers on his championship experience:

“Zach Randolph asked me to show the team my championship rings when I got here”

Mario Chalmers on Zach Randolph, Jan 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Zach Randolph, Bonzi Wells
item.description:
Mason Plumlee:

“I really liked the team that went to the Western Conference Finals (in 2000). I don't know if there was any one player. The Rasheed (Wallace), Bonzi (Wells) team. Bonzi Wells played at Ball State, so I kind of liked him. I don't know if he's one of the great Blazers. (smiles) But I like that he was from Indiana. Zach Randolph, too.”

Mason Plumlee on Zach Randolph, Bonzi Wells, Dec 22, 2015. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Zach Randolph, David West, Andre Drummond
item.description:
Stan Van Gundy:

“Um...you know I'll be honest -- I go back and forth on it. I really do. Because I think Greg is an outstanding player and I think he's a high-character guy as well. And I think those are the guys that you generally want to build around. But I don't think that, you know, he and Andre Drummond are the best fit. Not saying you couldn't make it work, but certainly not the best fit. First of all, I think the game is moving smaller and quicker as it is. The teams that have continued to play with two big guys - at least one if not both are guys who can step away and make shots. Indiana played with David West. Memphis plays with Zach Randolph. Those guys can all go 17, 18 feet and make shots.”

Stan Van Gundy on Zach Randolph, David West, Andre Drummond, Aug 5, 2015. Source: Detroit Bad Boys.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Zach Randolph
item.description:
“Pau is old enough and he is going to decide what is best for him. We will play together this summer if everything goes well, but next season you never know. I have one of the best teammates in Zach (Randolph), we know each other and we can play together... I have no idea how Pau would feel about coming off the bench”

Marc Gasol on Zach Randolph, May 13, 2014. Source: Marca.com.

item.title: Jason Levien on Zach Randolph
item.description:
Jason Levien on trading Zach Randolph:

“There was never a serious discussion or dialogue around trading Zach Randolph. I can say that categorically. We’re really proud of him for going back to the All-Star Game.”

Jason Levien on Zach Randolph, Feb 12, 2013. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Zach Randolph, Marc Gasol
item.description:
His response was just as inexplicable as his decision to keep his best perimeter defender (Tony Allen) on the bench for almost all of the fourth quarter while the Clippers made a run.

“If [Randolph and Gasol] took seven shots and made none [in the second half], that should tell you why we went away from it,”

Lionel Hollins on Zach Randolph, Marc Gasol, May 10, 2012. Source: CBSSports.com.
